answer.No Data Found: No data available for the specified criteria.

context.No context available: No context is available in the dataset.
context.No specific context: There is no specific context available for this request.

tags.Metadata: The question should retrieve metadata related to the dataset.
tags.Embedding: The question should retrieve from embeddings.
tags.Multi-level reasoning: More than one level of reasoning is required to answer the question.
tags.Chain of thoughts: The question requires multi-level thoughts of its own to arrive at the answer.
tags.Conditional reasoning: One reasoning is dependent on another.
tags.Insight generation: The question should generate insights from the data.
tags.Stability test: The question is used to test the stability of the solution. (Same question in different paraphrases should yield the same answer.)
